name: Saturn's Subtitle Tweaks
description: Saturn's Subtitle Tweaks (SST) adds Find subtitles to the Jellyfin Web playback subtitle menu. v1.1.2.0 injects the client script into /web/index.html so the button can appear during playback.
overview: In-player subtitle search for Jellyfin Web.

versions.changelog: Inject SST into jellyfin-web index.html on each /web load so Find subtitles appears in the CC action sheet. Serve /web/sst.js directly. Match Jellyfin 10.11 action sheet markup.
